plugins.contactsPermission: I'm In opens your contacts only when you choose someone to vouch for. It checks that one person's number and never uploads your contacts.

plugins.photosPermission: I'm In uses your photos so you can add a profile picture and photos to your pins.
plugins.cameraPermission: I'm In uses your camera so you can take photos and videos for your posts, your profile picture, or a verification selfie.
plugins.microphonePermission: I'm In uses your microphone to record sound with videos you post.

plugins.calendarPermission: I'm In puts events you're going to on your calendar, only when you tap Add to calendar.
plugins.writeOnlyCalendarPermission: I'm In puts events you're going to on your calendar, only when you tap Add to calendar.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: I'm In uses your approximate location to show pins and people near you. Your exact location is never shown to anyone.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: I'm In can notice when you arrive at an event or place you said I'm In to, even when the app is closed, so the people you chose see you're there. It only watches those places, and your exact location is never shown to anyone.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: I'm In can notice when you arrive at an event or place you said I'm In to, even when the app is closed, so the people you chose see you're there. It only watches those places, and your exact location is never shown to anyone.

plugins.cameraPermission: I'm In uses your camera to take Outs and boomerangs, and to scan a friend's QR code so you can connect.
